assets.title: Frame-Supported Linen Hamper Cart
assets.description: One original static laundry hamper cart with an empty thick tapered fabric basket, gently folded faceted walls, a continuous thick floor and a broad turned-over top cuff. The cuff is genuinely seated into a separate complete metal top rim. Four slim posts, lower side rails and end crossbars connect to four separate fixed caster assemblies with real fork-side gaps and finite flat tread contacts. The open chamber and the space under the suspended basket remain visible; no laundry, solid filler, lid, floor platform or surrounding scene is included. Named closed editable components, five constant solid PBR materials, metres, source Z up, front -Y and ground-centre origin. One cart including basket, frame and four wheels counts as one prop. Independently authored fabric-hamper construction, not a harvest basket or produce crate with wheels or a recolored logistics cage. Static game-art only: no cloth deformation, folding, rolling, steering, carrying capacity, load, hygiene, ergonomics, washing-appliance compatibility, manufacture or safety certification.
